# NEW 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP11 Full Roman Empire Theme System Expansion (4 Praetorian Prefectures + 79 Regions + E01-E10).
# Generated by gen_v260_theme_empire.py from data/oe_theme_regions_empire.json; edit the SSOT/generator, not this file.

on_game_start = { on_actions = { oe_theme_empire_on_start } }
on_game_started_after_lobby = { on_actions = { oe_theme_empire_after_lobby } }
on_new_country_formed = { on_actions = { oe_theme_empire_on_formed } }
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_theme_empire_monthly_pulse } }

oe_theme_empire_on_start = {
    effect = {
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
    }
}

oe_theme_empire_after_lobby = {
    effect = {
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire }
            global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Immediate BYZ -> ROM tag-swap synchronization so IOs & all 12 theme building types stay 100% intact.
oe_theme_empire_on_formed = {
    trigger = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            tag = ROM
            tag = BYZ
            has_or_had_tag = BYZ
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
    }
}

oe_theme_empire_monthly_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
    }
    effect = {
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_theme_regions_empire_assigned } }
            oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
        }
        oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 1 }
            oe_theme_reconcile_occupied = yes
        }
    }
}
